boc_board_mid.note: Midpoint of the two BOC quotes taken from the same snapshot, so no timing mismatch is introduced.

fx_spread_pct_one_way.note: Half the bank's published bid-ask spread, expressed against the midpoint of that same pair of quotes. This is the estimated cost of one one-way conversion relative to mid.

rails.name: Bank of China wire
rails.notes: 0.1% of the CNY amount, min CNY 50, max CNY 260, plus CNY 150 cable. Receiving charge is Chase's published USD 15, used as a representative US bank fee.

rails.name: HSBC China wire (Premier)
rails.notes: Commission and cable only. HSBC publishes no FX spread in the tariff read, so its all-in total is blank rather than borrowed from another bank. Its inbound wire into HSBC China is listed free, which is not the same as a US receiving bank being free.

rails.name: HSBC Global Transfer (Premier, same-name)
rails.notes: Service fee waived for Premier by tariff. FX spread unpublished, so all-in is blank. Requires an HSBC account in the destination country.

rails.name: Wise CNY to USD
rails.notes: Wise states the fee depends on delivery method and is only displayed when a transfer is created. No figure is published to copy, so the column stays blank.

penalties.quote: 逃汇…处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 (Art. 39); 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇…处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 (Art. 45); 违反规定携带外汇出入境…可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款 (Art. 42)

tax_scenarios.title: Your own already-taxed savings
tax_scenarios.us_rate: 0% on the principal; FX gain under USD 200 not recognised
tax_scenarios.assumption: The money was earned and taxed in earlier years and no new income or gain arises.

tax_scenarios.title: Unremitted salary earned in China
tax_scenarios.us_rate: Taxable wages; foreign tax credit for Chinese tax on the same income
tax_scenarios.assumption: China withholdings were correct and the US return includes the wages.

tax_scenarios.title: Gain on sale of property or other assets
tax_scenarios.us_rate: Capital gain; foreign tax credit potentially available
tax_scenarios.assumption: Assumes the disposal is real and the cost basis is documented in CNY.

tax_scenarios.title: Interest and dividends in the Chinese account
tax_scenarios.us_rate: Ordinary or qualified dividend treatment; credit for Chinese tax
tax_scenarios.assumption: Assumes the income was not already included on a prior US return.

tax_scenarios.title: Gift or bequest from a Chinese relative
tax_scenarios.china_rate: Not a China income event for you; donor side not verified
tax_scenarios.us_rate: No income tax; Form 3520 above USD 100,000 aggregate

reporting.trigger: Aggregate foreign financial accounts exceed USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year
reporting.cost_of_missing: Civil penalties adjusted annually for inflation; criminal exposure exists

reporting.trigger: US-resident single filer: over USD 50,000 at year end or USD 75,000 at any time; MFJ: USD 100,000 / USD 150,000. Higher thresholds apply to filers living abroad.
reporting.due: With the income tax return, including extensions
reporting.cost_of_missing: Up to USD 10,000, plus USD 10,000 per 30 days after notice, maximum USD 60,000

reporting.trigger: Gifts or bequests from a nonresident individual or foreign estate exceeding USD 100,000 aggregate in the year
reporting.due: 15 April, or 15 June for citizens living abroad; extensions capped at 15 October
reporting.cost_of_missing: Penalties under IRC 6039F(c) where reasonable cause is absent

reporting.trigger: Physically transporting more than USD 10,000 in currency or monetary instruments into or out of the US
reporting.cost_of_missing: Separate US offence; declaration is not optional

reporting.trigger: Claiming a credit for Chinese tax on income also taxed by the US
reporting.cost_of_missing: Not a penalty; you simply pay twice on the same income
